actual: Lane K pass, Cricmax - Home Location. The class wizard has only 7 steps (Program, Schedule, Coach, Location & Slots, Capacity, Sessions, Preview) and no Price step — there is nowhere to enter a price, so "$20 a session" cannot be produced. The Programs list has no Price column (Class, Schedule, Coaches, Enrolled, Status, Actions). The class overview (Overview, Roster, Schedule & Sessions tabs) has no Price row; program details show only Sport, Age group, Days/Time, Location, Term, Sessions, Coach. No "Needs a price" text appears anywhere; the priceless class created in this pass (QA_AP 576 Class, programs/189) shows no price indicator (status Upcoming). A follow-up look-only check confirmed there is no "Programs v2" area in this build (no sidebar entry, no toggle in Preferences, /programs-v2 redirects to the Dashboard), so no alternate priced-class flow exists.
expected: The class wizard has a Price step; the Programs list has a Price column; the class overview has a Price row; an old class with no price shows "Needs a price".
steps: Open Programs > New class and list the wizard steps; look for a Price step.
Check the Programs list columns for a Price column.
Open a class overview and look for a Price row.
Create a class with no price and look for a "Needs a price" indicator.
title: QXR-576: no class pricing surface at all — no Price step, column, or row; no 'Needs a price'
